profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: What happens when you combine 8+ years of Java expertise with a keen eye for seeing the bigger picture? Systems that process millions of healthcare records seamlessly, reporting tools that deliver insights in seconds instead of minutes, and development teams that ship faster than ever. I specialize in the sweet spot between cutting-edge technology and real-world impact—whether that's migrating enterprise systems to the cloud or implementing bot detection that actually works.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: El Segundo, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
●	Architect and lead development on services
●	Design and implement reporting datalake in Athena and revamp reporting tools for 90% time reduction
●	Modernize emailing system for distributed delivery and user retention
●	Enhance bot detection mechanisms for reporting and user maintenance 
●	Update admin console from JSP to React
●	Implement user friendly scheduling system for marketing campaigns
●	Research uses for LLM in emails and article summarization

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Agile Coach
positions.description:
●	Develop in Java and maintain interoperability bus for EHRs and micro-services
●	Design and lead offshore AWS/OpenShift micro-service infrastructure, development and migration
●	Architect Java micro-services to support data transfer to data lake from connected services
●	Design and drive migration effort from Oracle database to AWS Elasticsearch for transactional data
●	Lead Tiger Team to redesign crucial communication flow of data through interoperability bus
●	Code enhancements for OpenShift based Java micro-service integrating Kafka with MSK via REST Proxy
●	Lead Docker containerization effort through development of Java micro-services to be platform agnostic
●	Implement continuous integration practices for Java micro-services via Jenkins
●	Maintain adherence to ONC 2015 standards for clinical documents
●	Participate in team on-call rotation for team micro-services and priority issues
●	Lead team scrum activities such as planning, grooming, and retrospective
●	Mentor summer futures and new hires

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Integrate with 3rd party API’s including REST, FHIR and SOAP communication
●	Modernize team management through agile development and repository conversions
●	Lead team monitoring and logging development with Grafana and ELK stack.
●	Assist with FHIR/Java development for ONC Certification

positions.title: Teachers Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted classes: Programming I, Programming II, Data Structures, Mobile Computing: Android
•	Assist students and professor through introductory computer programming class
•	Assist in consistent grading of assignments and exams
•	Lead class in absence of the professor
•	Host lab sessions for students to receive extra aid

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Develop new platform for Garmin Connect Partners to request API Access
•	Maintain and improve Garmin Connect platform
•	Analyze business data and provide detailed spreadsheet on given topic
•	Assist in the completion of development for Strava partnership

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
•	Convert previous databases to the company's production standard using Informatica
•	Adapt stored data to business requirements and load into storage
•	Provide opinions/solutions for development of Medical Supplement Analytics Project
•	Help develop Medical Supplement Analytics tool

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Update news stories daily
- Perform maintenance when necessary
- Modify events web broadcast when applicable

positions.title: Referee
positions.description:
•	Mentored children on the rules of soccer
•	Led soccer games, enforced and explained the rules, and made sure the players had a fun time
•	Encouraged proper parent sideline behavior
